summary: The change adds assistant conversations to shared apps. It covers stored instructions and a runtime definition endpoint, a separate inference budget for app VMs, host-signed viewer tokens, and per-viewer conversation storage on the app VM. All three round-1 findings are fixed. The last model step now sends tool_choice "none", and an empty reply becomes an explicit error; both are tested. The sharing.md example follows the typed-input pattern in api.md, and the text now states that every published app can hold conversations. A new temp unit test covers viewer-token expiry, tampering and a token from another host. All temp tests pass and every changed line is covered or exempt with an acceptable reason.
